entry.title: MMFlash: Faster Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models. Speculative decoding accelerates generation by letting a lightweight drafter propose tokens for parallel verification by a target model.
entry.summary:
Speculative decoding accelerates generation by letting a lightweight drafter propose tokens for parallel verification by a target model. Diffusion drafters such as DFlash propose an entire token block in a single forward pass, but mainly focus on text-only tasks, leaving multimodal drafting underexplored. To study this setting, we first introduce a metric of token-level visual dependence based on the KL divergence between next-token distributions with and without visual input.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #clean-tech #computer-vision

entry.title: JVT: Just Video Transformer makes pixel-space video diffusion simple
entry.summary:
Direct diffusion modeling of high-dimensional raw video data is challenging, and existing pixel-space methods often rely on specialized architectures. We introduce JVT (Just Video Transformer), a simple large-patch DiT-style Transformer for pixel-space video diffusion, without a pretrained autoencoder, auxiliary detailers, cascaded stages, or U-Net-style skip connections. We systematically examine video patch embeddings, register tokens, and adaptive layer normalization to identify design choices that balance generation quality and computational efficiency.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #clean-tech #computer-vision

entry.title: VibePrevisBench: Evaluating Agentic Coding for 4D Scene Generation in Blender
entry.summary:
Controllable real-world video generation models can condition on a rendered graybox proxy video, which fixes layout, motion and camera. Coding agents can build such videos by reconstructing a 4D scene in Blender, yet no benchmark checks both these videos and the long, multi-shot scenes behind them. We introduce VibePrevisBench, a benchmark for 4D scene reconstruction: an agent turns a brief into an executable 4D scene and renders its proxy video.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #agents

entry.title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
entry.summary:
We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds.

entry.title: Rethinking in Spikes: Mitigating Hallucinations in MDLMs with Step-Aware Decoding
entry.summary:
Recent advancements in multimodal diffusion language models (MDLMs) have exhibited strong global modeling capabilities through iterative refinement. We observe that mask uncertainty follows an overall downward trend during iterative denoising, while a few denoising steps exhibit localized entropy spikes closely associated with hallucinations. We argue that anomalous steps can be identified by measuring the entropy deviation of each denoising step from its neighboring temporal window.

entry.title: Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems. The release of GPT-6 Astra marks the emergence of a new paradigm in robotics: agentic robotics.
entry.summary:
The release of GPT-6 Astra marks the emergence of a new paradigm in robotics: agentic robotics. Within weeks, frontier models with agentic harnesses matched or exceeded task-specific policies on many embodied benchmarks. Instead of training a dedicated policy for each family of tasks, an agentic robotic system applies a foundation model to open-world embodied tasks.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #agents #robotics

entry.title: MIRIX-2.0: Multi-Agent Memory System. Long-term memory lets LLM agents personalize, stay consistent, and reuse what worked before.
entry.summary:
Long-term memory lets LLM agents personalize, stay consistent, and reuse what worked before. Parametric memories need training, consolidation can lose details for good, and keeping every record leaves a growing store to search. We present MIRIX-2.0, a multi-agent memory system designed to be practical, accurate, and efficient at once.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #combinatorics #agents

entry.title: V-JEPA-LM: Video-Language Models That Read Dynamics Beyond Static, Text-Aligned Representations
entry.summary:
World-model video encoders such as V-JEPA learn how scenes change (direction, speed, order, state) from video alone. To answer questions, they are joined to a language model trained on captions and question-answer pairs. But each caption or question names only a few attributes of a clip, so the model learns to retrieve those attributes rather than to read the clip, and the dynamics the encoder carries go unused: on the same items, a linear probe reads speed from frozen V-JEPA features at 87% while the VLM answers at chance.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights
